title: Great for kids with special needs!
text:
I work with a lot of kids and adults with special needs and also have a sister who has Angelman's Syndrome. About 99% of the individuals I work with HATE oral care and fight against it every step of the way. I have used these toothbrushes with many of my clients and just recently purchased some for my sister. I'm so pleased with them!

First, it is much easier to get these toothbrushes into their mouths, which are usually almost clamped shut. Second, it is much easier to move them around the mouth to reach all the teeth (even the very back ones) since the toothbrush head is somewhat smaller than a regular toothbrush. Third, since implementing the use of these toothbrushes my clients' dentists have been very impressed with the improvement of the cleanliness of the teeth and gums. This is very good news for people who must be both sedated and held down/put on a papoose board in order to have any dental work done.

I should mention that if you buy these for someone who often bites down on the toothbrush, it may need to be replaced more often than a regular toothbrush ( like every 2-3 months) due to the damage of the head and bristles. That being said, these things are pretty darn durable!

Cleaner teeth -> less time in the dental chair -> Less emotional and physical stress on both patients and caregivers -> greater happiness for everyone involved. If you care for anyone with special needs and are questioning whether or not to invest in this product, just do it. It is sooo worth the investment.

title: The silver bullet for small breed teeth problems.
text:
We have a lot of dogs and they’re chihuahuas. They are known for having notoriously bad teeth as a breed even when you do everything right. Our littlest has been losing teeth left and right and is at the age where cleanings are too scary with her size. She would realistically need a cleaning much more often than yearly because the plaque builds up so fast.

I bought this as a shot in the dark, as we have burned hundreds on every product known to man. I mixed the product parts together in the large bottle and sprayed 4 of our dogs’ teeth as instructed. After a SINGLE application, our girl with the bad teeth had a 25% reduction in plaque. Our other three had a reduction of 40%, 60%, and 90%. I am not joking - this stuff has carbolic acid in it and it WORKS. The two components mixed causes some type of fizzy reaction and really works between the plaque and teeth/gums and between teeth. I tasted it first myself to be sure it wouldn’t be traumatizing to our pups and it tastes like flavorless alcohol free mouthwash.

Since, I continue to spray once or twice a day as I remember to and the plaque keeps disappearing. I did check with my dental tools to be sure it wasn’t just bleaching the plaque and it is not- it’s physically breaking off their teeth. I don’t know how we will get larger bottles of the stuff with the number of dogs we have but it’s true, it works. I paid my actual money and used it on my real dogs. This is not a paid or discounted review. Please give this a shot on your Littles!

I’ve had my bar for almost two months now and I’m still getting use out of it and I love it! I have waist length fine hair and hard water. I wash my hair 3-5x per week and this little guy is still hanging in there after about two months. It started to crumble after about a month, but I put it in a mesh soap saver bag and it still works great. The shampoo cleans my hair nicely without drying out my hair. I’ve noticed that I use much less conditioner. I might even try forgoing conditioner all together. I’ve also traveled with it and it still worked great regardless of water hardness or softness. Other bars I’ve tried left a greasy film, making my hair feel waxy, but this one hasn’t!  The one thing I don’t love is the smell, but it’s tolerable for me. The benefits outweigh the smell and I’ve honestly just gotten used to it at this point. Overall, highly recommended this little shampoo bar!

title: I wanted to love it but...

I wet my hair in the shower and applied it to the roots of my hair and worked it outward.  It required that I add additional water to my hair to lather up whereas bottled shampoo I would not have to do that.  The smell was challenging for me.  I rinsed my hair and did not use conditioner (I typically do use conditioner).  It was not easy to comb through my hair.  When my hair dried, it did look pretty good and the smell was very mild.  The next day I repeated everything but this time I used my normal conditioner.  My hair was easier to comb through and softer.  I would bring this on vacation because it is easy to pack but I'm not sure that I would use it on a regular basis because I really don't like the smell when shampooing. I was really hoping that I wouldn't need conditioner.

title: Great when you've blowdried your Caucasian curly frizz straight
text: I have curly, frizzy mousy hair which I've been highlighting blonde for nearly 40 years. I had it chemically straightened for over a decade and finally stopped when my hair started breaking. I've spent hundreds of dollars on haircare products from all the aisles. Many of them, including but not limited to the African hair care products, weighed my hair down or just gave me greasy frizz.  The products advertised as fighting frizz for three days lasted perhaps a couple of hours before I had to apply more. This wax is expensive and smells funny and it doesn't work well on my hair if I just leave it to dry naturally into its own mess of ringlets and frizz. However, when I have styled my hair straight with the blowdryer, it's fabulous. It adds shine and softness, one application lasts 6-8 hours and the tin is easy to carry around for touchups. I didn't need to use a lot of wax at a time and even with near daily use, the tin lasted me around three months. I disliked the smell but it wears off quickly. (Haircare tips for fellow frizzies: I use a this Garnier leave-in conditioner [[ASIN:B005GQ6HUK Garnier Fructis Sleek & Shine Intensely Smooth Leave-In Conditioning Cream, 10.2 Fl. Oz.]] after shampooing and I only shampoo once a fortnight. In between, I wash with plain water in the shower and apply more leave-in conditioner. This regime has significantly improved my hair.)

title: More silicone than argan oil. Actual ingredients not clearly listed.
text:
I bought this because the seller listed the main ingredients as argan oil and resvesterol, when in fact the product is full of silicon and demethicone is listed before argan oil. I can see why there are rave reviews from other users. This will give your hair a great TEMPORARY shine and silky soft feel but will end up robbing it of shine shortly and prevent your hair from absorbing moisture. You are not coating your hair with Arian oil but a rubber derivative. So th cuticle lays down short term but never gets the moisture that is causing the damage and frizz to begin with. I think someone who has science in their name would know that. Long term demethicone use will cause more drying and damage and is not good for your hair.

I had actually wanted to use this product on my face, not hair because of the resvesterol. But it has an extremely strong scent of sandalwood that is overpowering and I would never be able to use it on my face.

The bottle arrived in a box but leaked all over. I would have returned anyway because of the demethicone and smell. I bought pure cold pressed argan oil to use instead. It smells naturally like poo as all of them do but the smell dissipates in a few minutes.

I do think the seller should make its ingredients clear to prospective buyers and not just list the deceptive "main ingredients" omitting the ingredients that are listed first when the package actually arrives and therefore are really the main ingredients.

title: I've had 1 jar for over a year
text: I use this product on my self and my two daughters when we want to do wash and go's. Per the list of ingredients it is many waxes and moisturizers used to seal in the moisture the hair needs to maintain a curl so, yes it feels like a thick waxy pomade but once dried (and if applied properly) there is no flaking or white residue left behind.. what works for us is using after lightly rinsing conditioner out but not fully leaving the hair slightly "squishy". Then using  a measuring spoon scoop out 1-2 tablespoons (depending on length of hair) and separate that measured amount for the separated sections of hair.. adding a few drops of your favorite hair oil to each portion while in hand will make it almost lather up a bit to make it easier to work through hair... this is a buildable curl control so refreshing with a little product every shower helps keep style till wash day. This can also act as a heat protectant/frizz reducer if instead of washing out completely on wash day you pre-poo, leaving trace amount of product so when you blow dry and flat iron its stays straighter for longer. Although the price might seem hefty considering all the other products it replaced and how long 1 jar lasted the 3 of us it is definitely worth it. We kept it sealed and made sure not to leave hair or water in the jar and it seemed as fresh as the day we bought it the whole time. This is also a great product for summertime fun when used regularly as my teenager uses it at all the water parks and it does not wash out in the pool water like other products and helps maintain some kind of curl control even in chlorinated water.. It takes a little practice but once you get in the routine this product is amazing!!

title: Hirsute men can rejoice
text:
I'm a member of the Perennially Hairy Club. I have coarse hair all over which, while indicative of my inherently virile nature, is a bit of a put off for women who've been weened on celebrity lady-boys. I've searched (in vain) for a product that does what it advertises, and does it without making me want to scrape my skin off. The Bare Pair delivers. First, it's got a completely inoffensive smell which is kinda nice considering that you have to wear the stuff for 15 minutes or more at a time. Second, it doesn't leave me with burning, ingrown-hair bumps that make me feel even more disgusting than my natural, gorrilla-like state.

The key is to remember that for truly manly-type hairy guys you're probably gonna have to go two or three rounds with this stuff before you see the full effect. You're also going to want to invest in something like the [[ASIN:B0037HP9OA Philips Norelco BG2040/34 Philips Norelco Bodygroom Pro Grooming System, Black / Silver]] in order to keep maintenance to a reasonable minumum.

I've used this stuff on my back, arms and nether regions, with complete success in all areas (though again I caution that two or three applications were required to achieve the desired effect). I've left my chest and legs untouched because I'm not going to entirely deny my Nordic/Viking hairy awesomeness, but I don't doubt that a similarly patient approach to those areas would leave me as smooth as a very smooth thing.

I can absolutely 100 percent validate and testify to the the genuine sincerity and humility that radiates throughout Andy's life. He is unflappably kind and exhaustively gracious both in his business and interpersonal life.

title: What you need to know before you buy
text:
The stuff is great! I purchased this to take on our recent vacation during airport travel and disney world. I wanted something I could use with my 3 year old daughter that could actually provide full coverage of her hands. The gel hand sanitizers drip off of her hands before she has a chance to get them together quickly. She also doesn't understand how to rub her hands together completely, coating both the front and back. I figured this sanitizer would do the trick, and it did.

I was able to carry a few napkins with me, I would completely saturate my daughters hands with this, front and back then then have her rub them together for about 15 seconds and dry them with the napkin. It was like a mini hand washing and was great as I used this technique myself and felt so much better after doing it. I also had peace of mind that my children had sanitized hands periodically. I know this in no way took the place of real hand washing but it worked great in a pinch.

While it is unscented I can't say that it doesn't have an odor, it smells like you've just dunked your hands in a bucket of diluted bleach and water, or a heavily chlorinated pool. It's not a bad smell but definitely smells bleachy. It's by no means offensive like strongly scented sanitizer but it is there and it is noticeable but it's refreshing, in a good gentle way.

Overall this is stuff is great and so much better than strongly scented gel sanitizer that plops to the floor (or your clothes) before or during being spread.

Pros:
You only need a few sprays to coat hands
Last a long time
No offensive strong scent
Is allowed on airplanes so it's great for travel

Cons:
(Barely a con) Leaves a bleach like smell on your hands, it's not strong or offensive but it is noticeable. I just thought this needed to be noted.

title: Good for just about everything!

text:

When I received my order, a little of the product had leaked out, but nothing significant. Also, sometimes the product comes out a runny liquid rather than in mousse form. title: Afordable and easy way to stay tan all year long
text:

First off the smell is devine. Especially compared to previous self tanners I've used. Does not have a strong fake tan smell, and I also don't notice the smell lingering on my skin for extended periods of time.

The color of this product is great and never looks orange or gives me that too dark/red fake tan look I've experienced with other products. The color probably lasts me 4 days, depending on how often I wash my body, workout, and shave. As with all self-tanning products I don't find the "extreme" color to be very dark. I typically apply two coats to get my desired color, which is roughly 2-3 shades darker.

VERYY easy to apply. I use this with the [[ Premium Tanning Applicator Mitt Double-Sided Soft Microfiber Glove for Streak-Free Application]] and don't typically have any problems with streaking. I have noticed I can get streaky on my legs if I apply the product too quickly and don't pay close enough attention, but I don't know any self tanner that wouldn't be an issue with.

My only issue with this product is that I've noticed is coming off on my clothes the day I use it. Even if I use it in the morning and don't wear tight-fitting or light colored clothes until over 8 hours later it will still come off on them. I've noticed it the most on my light wash jean shorts. Fortunately, the color comes off in the wash, but be prepared to plan a head if you want to use this prior to wearing light colored shorts.

Other than that AMAZING product. Definitely worth the price in my opinion.

title: Proceed With Extreme Caution
text:
I'm really torn on this review. If I could give it 2.5 stars, I would. It does have a considerable pro or two, but it also is laden with a lot of items in the "cons" column. So first, the good stuff: SugarBaby delivers on its promise to provide a dark bronze tan. The color is deep and natural looking and develops quickly. Another unexpected pro with this product is that I found the "guide" to be a pretty color once it dried and settled, so if it was necessary to go out after tanning you wouldn't have the odd color found in some products' guides. Of course, the guide in itself is a pro also, as it always helps to be able to tell if you've missed a spot, gotten it streaky, where you left off, etc. The color also lasted a fair amount of time (6 days or so.)

Now to the cons. I had to apply the mousse with latex gloves (the result of a defective tanning mitt) and eventually the help of my husband. I was absolutely exhausted once I finished tanning the parts I could reach, and he finished my back and arms. Although it was a tremendous pain, it looked good and looked even. After 30 minutes, I still couldn't get dressed in even a loose robe because a few areas felt tacky to the touch. It was almost an hour before I felt sort of dry. I eventually put on very loose pajamas pants and a long sleeve t-shirt; 5 hours later I went to bed. In the morning, there was tanner on my duvet cover, sheets, and inside my clothes.

So, Pros: Good color, lasts fairly well
Cons: Backbreaking to apply, long drying time, color transfer onto fabrics

Reserve this one for when you don't mind the extra trouble to get really dark.
Tip: Apply it 1st thing a day around the house, wear baggy clothes, and as late at night as you can, shower off the guide. You'll have given yourself the 8-10 hours your tan needs to develop (and then some), plus you'll save your sheets AND wake up smelling DHA free. :)

title: The "HG" for Me
text: I first learned about this sunscreen from No BS Beauty (a no-nonsense, non-sponsored skincare enthusiast on YouTube). I was looking for something with good staying power, good filters (beyond FDA archaic limits), and no scent/fragrance for both everyday and outdoor activity sun exposure.  This hits all the marks. I have maturing skin (almost 50), and use tret, so UV exposure protection is a must. I've repurchased this one throughout the year (2022). It has never failed me: long, multi-hour summer hikes, summer outdoor wedding, and now, just as an SPF make-up primer for everyday life (work, errands, etc). I would say it does leave a slight white cast on my medium-olive skin tone, but that disappears with my sheer BB cream or foundation. It leaves a not-quite matte, smooth/silky, almost powdery finish that I appreciate because, having maturing combo-skin, I cannot stand all those highly praised "dewy" sunscreens that make me look greasy moreso than "dewy."  If you're seeking "dewy," this isn't it. I wouldn't say it's matte or drying either -- it just hits the sweet spot for me. I am a bit of a skincare nerd who wants to try out lots of different sunscreens, and I have no doubt there are amazing alternatives out there, but when you find something that works? At least in my case, I end the hunt and just hit re-order. Make sure you check the seller's storefront and ratings (always recommend that when purchasing J or Kbeauty skincare products from Amazon). This one is definitely worth trying and adding to your collection!

title: I love this face oil
text:
I love this face oil. It makes my skin look excellent and I can use it in place of a moisturizer without my skin breaking out or having excess oil. I would definitely recommend this product above any salon or high-end brands of vitamin c oils. The price was excellent. My only complaints are the following: 1) I personally have to use a lot to cover my face (5-6 drops) because I don't use other moisturizers. This means the product runs out fairly quickly. 2) Because it is an oil, it takes a long time to soak into my skin. this makes it very difficult to use under makeup as it makes my makeup cake and seep into my wrinkles. It's not flattering. If you don't use much, this may not be as much of a problem.
The pros, for me, outweigh the cons, though. It makes my skin look great. With my combination skin, it does not make my skin overly oily, it makes my skin feel soft, look younger, and brighter.

The vitamin C component in the oil (according to the label) is tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate, which according to my research is one of the "newer" forms of vitamin C for topical use. It has a "high" safety rating and is skin friendly because it is fat soluble and this makes it easier to absorb through the skin. It is suspended in other fruit oils that are traditionally good for the skin (red raspberry, like the other reviewer mentioned), preserving the integrity of the vitamin C (which spoils quickly in water). This makes the whole formulation skin-friendly and I see a significant difference in my skin after using it for only a few days. It is thick (it's made of true oils) but I highly recommend it.

title: Lightweight and effective

title: Great for Sensitive Eyes
text:
I have very dry eyes and, in addition, use three prescription eye drops at bedtime and first thing in the morning. Since I wear contacts, I put the drops in the morning then doze in bed for another fifteen or twenty minutes before it's time to insert my lenses. During this time, my eyes tear up a little from the medication. The tears, combined with drips of medicine, create crusts around my eyes that are irritating if I'm not careful about wiping them away. They often sting and I don't have time for that -- cats are calling for breakfast and I need my contact lenses on to see to feed them.

These wipes are terrific for cleaning away excess eye drops on my skin and lashes. They're thorough and don't sting and the wipes are big so I can use one side to do most of the cleaning turn it over to make sure my lashes are completely clear. There is no pain despite my dry eyes.

I wish I'd found these sooner, and I'm glad to have them. They make my morning routine less stingy and crusty!

text:
First of all, my hair is very long and I'm 56 so it is aging. It has gotten coarser, dryer, and duller as I've gotten older so what I need from a conditioner may be different than someone with a different type of hair. I found that this conditioner took about three days of use before it actually made my hair start to feel soft, but even after some time, it wasn't as soft as some other conditioners can make it. On the bright side, comb out was easier with this than some other conditioners. It also didn't weigh my hair down or flatten out the natural waves. It left my hair bouncy and full of body. However, it also didn't do much for shine enhancement or split ends/repair as far as I could tell.

The scent on this conditioner is very herb-like (as you'd expect) and not especially strong which I prefer in a conditioner as I don't like the scent lingering in my hair. It is fairly thick and a smaller amount goes a long way. I think the claims about "hydrating" are sound, but my hair isn't super dry or brittle (though it is a bit dry), but there are other qualities (softening, shine enhancement) that I wasn't satisfied with.

title: Not just for feet!
text:
The Silver Miracles Colloidal Silver Foot Cream isn’t just for feet. The antibacterial priorities make it excellent for killing foot odor which is why it’s marketed for feet. But… also here on Amazon, you can purchase silver infused socks that last much longer than a jar of ointment to cure foot issues.

The silver properties are excellent for first aid as well and in my opinion make better use of the ointment (based on cost effectiveness for purpose). It’s good for minor skin irritations, cuts, abrasions and especially burns.

It came in handy initially as I managed to burn myself promptly after receiving it. It helped the burn heal much faster, while keeping infection at bay, than if I had just let nature take its course.

I learned about the healing properties of colloidal silver about 20 years ago when my daughter burned herself as a little girl. The ER doctor sent us home with colloidal silver cream and it fixed her right up.

I like to keep it on hand now for just such emergencies. Highly recommended.

title: Anti-bacterial ointment for cuts, scrapes, burns, rash, etc.
text:
This jar of Colloidal Silver Foot Cream by Silver Miracles arrived with a double safety seal. A clear plastic seal outside and internally, under the lid, another seal.

It is white and the cream is easy to use and once applied is easy to massage into the skin.

I’m not exactly sure why this is Foot Cream, as it has many uses on the body.

My first exposure to this type of product occurred when I needed a remedy for poison ivy. While it is not intended for that, it can help with reducing the spread of poison ivy and did seem to help mine heal faster. I did rely mostly on drying lotions like Calamine, to stop the oozing.

You are instructed to first wash the affected area, then dry it, before applying this cream. So, it’s not really like a lot of other creams which you simply apply. I suppose you will still benefit from it if it is not washed, but the label was referencing feet, which can get really dirty. Wash hands after use.

This is a great cream for small cuts, rashes, insect bites and burns.

Recommended

title: Typical foot cream ingredients, but with Colloidal Silver added
text: According to the product label, the purpose of the Silver Miracles Colloidal Silver Foot Cream is to hydrate, lubricate, moisturize, and soothe dry skin, AND kill odor-causing bacteria. From what I can tell, it seems to do this, but not in a dramatic fashion. The ingredients include Almond Oil, Cocoa Seed Butter, Shea Butter, Coconut Oil, Urea, Peppermint Oil, Menthol, and Colloidal Silver. As others have pointed out, the cream spreads easy enough but doesn't seem to absorb that well into the skin. Also, the dinky-sized jar only contains 2-ounces. So, you'll probably go through the bottle fairly quickly if you follow the instructions and apply liberally. It's a decent foot cream overall but seems a little pricey for the small amount you get.

title: Isopropyl-based hand sanitizer that meets both CDC & WHO guidelines
text:
Much of the hand sanitizer we have been using is ETHYL alcohol (ethanol) based. THIS sanitizer is ISOPROPYL alcohol based. Note that historically most hand sanitizer has been based on isopropyl alcohol whereas ethanol has been used in things like alcohol that you drink of as a gasoline additive for oxygenated fuels (for environmental purposes) as well as other purposes. Isopropyl has been used in hand sanitizer and "rubbing alcohol" among other things. Both are now approved for use in hand sanitizer. Ethynol-based sanitzers are becoming much more common due to high demand and supply constraints on Isopropyl-based sanitizers.

The interesting thing is that the CDC and WHO have different guidelines for hand sanitizer effectiveness for these two types of alcohol:
CDC: Ethyl - at least 60%, Isopropyl - at least 70%
WHO: Ethyl - at least 80%, Isopropyl - at least 75%
You can see that it is interesting that the CDC recommends higher concentrations of Isopropyl whereas WHO recommends higher concentrations of Ethyl. Curious. Rather than dig into too many details on the difference, the easiest thing is to find a way to meet both...

The most common ethyl alcohol hand sanitizers that we have been getting (and the most common out there) are 70% -- which exceeds CDC 60% threshold, but is below the 80% WHO threshold.

THIS SANITIZER has an ISOPROPYL concentration of 75% which exceeds the CDC 70% threshold and meets the WHO 75% threshold.

Clearly these thresholds are not hard limits as indicated by the difference of opinion between CDC and WHO, but it is mildly comforting to meet both recommendations if you can do so with no downside or extra expense.

WHAT I LIKE:
* Easily squeezes out of bottle in controlled amount as a gel
* Rubs in easily and absorbs within less than a minute to leave no noticeable residue or tackiness on your hands
* Aloe helps to keep your hands moist, fighting the drying effects of the alcohol
* Small bottles are easy to take in car, backpack, purse, etc.
* Scent is minor and dissipates quickly (we're not using this for its smell after all)

SUMMARY:
A cost effective way to keep you hands sanitized when you can't use soap & water. Meets both CDC and WHO guidelines for effective hand sanitizer formulations.

title: ~ Graciously Unassuming / Undeniably Fabulous! ~
text:
Woolzies has outdone themselves yet again with their 100% Sweet Almond Oil!! I can not say an adequate number of glorious things about this stuff!I use it for everything ranging from homemade face scrub, shampoo, and moisturizer… to body mist, massage oil, lip balm, and shaving cream!! I have mixed it with homemade pet shampoo, added to foot soak, combed it through wet or damp hair and FINALLY MY LATEST OBSESSION…

BLENDING IT INTO MY SMOOTHIES!!
YUP! When I make smoothies with a great deal of vitamin K (such as kale) or pro-vitamin A (such as carrots or apricots) the sweet almond oil (Excellent Source of MUFAs) improves the absorption of these fat-soluble nutrients into my body!
It also contains a truckload of vitamin E (Antioxidant) which aids in boosting the immune system, supports a healthy inflammatory response and benefits as a cicatrizant, “ A medicine or application that promotes the healing of a sore or wound, or the formation of a cicatrix. [1913 Webster]”

So yeah… this stuff is truly badass! BEST PART... this particular sweet almond oil is extremely mellow in fragrance and flavor. In fact, if I were not the one blending together the ingredients I would be oblivious to its existence in the mix.

In any case…I read a review that claimed the scent or flavor of this oil was not the finest, which perhaps could be the ‘pseudo truth’ IF someone was expecting an intensely rich almond essence. (This is what would be found in bitter almond oil. Actually known as almond essential oil)

Nevertheless, the ‘aroma/flavor’ or better yet, the lack there of, contained within this particular oil is precisely what I look for when I purchase a product that can be incorporated into my diet or included in so many personal products. My intent is such that I can exercise full control over the fragrance or flavor of my creations. Typically I do so by mixing in some of my favorite essential oils, dried herbs or citrus zests.

In sum, I’ve tolerated many but valued only a few products as much as I do this oil. It has earned its place among my officially declared ‘household staple items’! For its versatility, benefits and purity Woolzies 100% Pure Sweet Almond Oil has officially won me over!

title: Colonoscopy Prep NECESSITY
text:
I recently had my first colonoscopy, and I had been warned that the prep was the worst part. Yeah, that was a total understatement. I am SO grateful to my mom, who told me to lay in a supply of this Balneol lotion to use when ... um ... tidying up after eliminating.

I will admit, I was skeptical. Lotion? For my BUM?! Turns out, that's a very definite YES.

If you've had a colonoscopy, you know that after you drink that concoction of vileness that they call the "prep drink," you're going to poop in much the same way that Vesuvius erupts. Trip after trip to the loo, right? Right. Oh, you thought you were done and could have a little lie-down to recover? Haha. NOPE! Why don't you just bring in War and Peace and sit here the rest of the day?

So after a few trips to the throne room, your bum feels a bit sore. Even the softest toilet tissue feels like 80-grit sandpaper rasping all the skin off your most delicate bits. And you can't stop going to the loo, because that death-potion you had to drink is ripping through you like a wildfire through a summer-dry grassland. In fact, your bum feels like it might BE on fire.

That's where this lotion stuff comes in. After gently patting the worst of the debris off your bum, you take a fresh piece of toilet roll and put a bit of this stuff on it. Use that to clean up the rest of you. The relief is instant, like a cup of ice-water after a mid-day hike through Death Valley in mid-August. And it does seem to make the cleanup more effective.

I imagine people with chronic digestive issues would also find this useful, and I know that on days when my "girl thing" is happening, it's a relief to clean up using this product. But if you're slated for a colonoscopy, you should most definitely lay in a supply of this stuff. You're gonna need it!

title: *DO NOT BUY*
text: Since I had read the reviews about expiration dates being so close or even EXPIRED, it was the first thing I checked when I received the oil. And, voilà!!! The expiration date has magically disappeared! As you can see from the photos I uploaded, there are nothing where there suppose to have EXPIRATION DATE on. In Korea, there are laws that require cosmetics to have expiration dates or have shelf lives on their labels, but in the U.S., there are no such laws or regulations for cosmetics. I think it's a reasonable assumption that they are selling the expired products after repackaging them with no printed expiration date where that is allowed. How shady are they deceiving overseas customers like this? Are they inferring that their products are "expired" by adding ("Old"/Korean Packaging) in the product description. No one would ever expect to PAY money for expired cosmetic products. Such a shame they are doing this. I'm truly disappointed because I really wanted to try this out. I'm returning the product.

title: I really like this!
text: I wasn't entirely sure what to expect, and other than charging instructions there's not a lot of user info in the small foldout (which I could barely read because the print is so small). But having used similar devices in the past, I was able to figure it out. After fully charging it, I clicked through the various settings and each pops up on the small screen telling you what it's for. When it comes in contact with your skin, it makes a little humming sound & vibrates. The various light settings are for different results which can be set to different intensities, and so far I'm enjoying using it. The lights feel warm on my skin, which is soothing. The setting w/o light produces a little charge/tingle, not unlike my NuFace device. While it's too soon to see any results, I'm enjoying using it and really like it so far. I've found it works best if you have either moisturizer or perhaps a serum on your skin to provide some slip, as on dry, bare skin it tugs and doesn't move as smoothly.

I got the best results using this on black nail polish and a top coat. I just used my pinky finger to apply the powder. I picked up just barely enough to fully coat my nail, being very careful not to waste any of it on the surrounding skin. It washes off, I just want every particle to go to use, lol. Just make sure you use a top coat that won't "shrink" your polish, because it makes flaws in the chrome finish. If anyone has any experience with Seche Vite, you probably know what I'm talking about. Would I recommend this? Absolutely. Yes, it's expensive, however, it's still only $20, and I expect this to last for quite a few manicures. title: Mirror finish, mesmerizing coloshift even wood beetles would envy
text:
Superfine powder. Amazing results.

NASA called, Webb telescope wants its mirror finish back.

UV gel steps:
-prep nails (file, push cuticle, lightly buff w coarse buffer, cleanse w alcohol to remove ALL debris and oils)
-tip: apply all coats thinly, THIN = STRONG, thick = will settle and cure thicker at tip and edges, prone to lifting peeling
-tip: remove uncured UV gel booboos from cuticle edges BEFORE they cure ROCK HARD on skin
-base coat, cure LED lamp (all cure cycles 60 seconds)
-color 1st coat, cure LED lamp (black no-wipe UV gel polish if you'll be using chrome powders) "no-wipe" means no tackiness after curing, no need to wipe w alcohol cleanser
-color 2nd coat, cure LED lamp (black no-wipe UV gel polish if you'll be using chrome powders)
-apply dusting of chrome powder, GENTLY rub in w eye shadow applicator, silicone applicator (love this tool, also found at art supply stores), NO OIL CROSS CONTAMINATION from fingertip or cuticle
-perfectly prepped and cured surface should yield mirror finish and color shift; if spots don't take powder, wipe seletively w alcohol cleanser and reapply powder, I achieved 100% coverage and blending
-tacky surface may yield less mirror and more "glitter-like" appearance
-top coat 1st coat (same clear as base coat), cure LED lamp
-top coat 2nd coat optional, cure; wipe tackiness w alcohol cleanser
-apply cuticle oil
-marvel at your accomplishment

title: Get this!
text: This photo was taken after a week and a half of having it on my nails. The gold that I used had started to wear off the tips of my nails but the milky white polish didn't budge! I really did my nails with just the white and stickers and I'm on week three with no chips or peeling. The key I've found is to lightly buff my nails and make sure there's no dust before applying a base coat and then I have been using 4 thin coats of the FANZEST polish to get a slightly more opaque look along with a top coat. I make sure my cuticles are pushed back, non of the polish touches my skin and that each coat is well cured. If you do all of those things you shouldn't have to re-do your nails until they grow out! I recommend this product!

title: The only brand I am brand loyal to
text:
My husband got this for me.

Honestly? I'm not a "brand" kind of girl. I just use whatever works and typically shun designer things and extremely overpriced branded things, but I've learned that sometimes a company CAN earn your loyalty. Essie is amazing nail polish! It's pigmented, smooth, the cut of the brush makes painting your nails extremely easy (even on my left hand which I am usually USELESS at!) and even without a clear top coat it lasts so much longer than other brands I've tried. I have small hands and petite nails, so a lot of brushes just make a mess even if I'm very careful, but I've never had an issue with an Essie brush. The cut of a nail polish brush may not be something a lot of people think about but once you find the right brush fit for you, you'll notice a H U G E difference!

The colors Essie offers are unique and beautiful, many of them universal for all skin tones from the palest porcelain to the deepest and richest ebony. And any brand that uses inclusive models for all their campaigns is alright with me, too.

All in all, I've ditched every other nail polish brand and I'm sticking to Essie from now on.

Oh, and Let It Glow is a really beautiful coral color with a golden shimmer that's perfect for spring and summer and the metallic effect is soft enough that even ridged nails can use it without it highlighting texture!

Review for 4th of July Nail Art Stickers Decals Patriotic Designer Nail Stickers 3D Nail Art Supplies Self Adhesive

This is a nice and varied set of patriotic nail stickers. You get 8 sheets so there are a lot to choose from. They are quite thin and delicate and need to be handled carefully or they will tear. title: Very sticky, good details, all sheets different.
text: Very good set, all sheets are diffferent. Size is decent, most of these stickers will fit on an adults nails. Some will fit on a pre-teens nails too. They do stick very well, and they dissolve under pressure and acetone-it takes a bit of time for that.  The details are really good!  Each sticker sheet measures 3 3/4 inches long and 2 1/2 inches wide.  There are some longer stickers - for those with longer nails this is great.  There are some stickers that no matter what won't fit on a normal sized nail and would have to be cut.  There are a lot of tiny hearts and star images that are super cool for little kids to enjoy or to add that little bit extra to a mani.  There is an assortment of flames, flags, peace hands, lips, numbers, uncle Sam hats, lots of hearts, butterflies, and birds. There are even a few high heels and vote checkmarks.  This is a fantastic collection that was well thought out and I'm super impressed.  For anyone with a need for speed to add decor to a mani, these stickers are the way.  We have lots of holidays that can be celebrated using patriotic stickers, such as Labor day, Presidents day, Veterans Day, 4th of July, Gold Star Mothers day, POW recognition day, and Pearl Harbor day.  These are all worthy of recognition with a special manicure.  These are easily lifted and placed using a sharp tipped pair of tweezers and they do stick well!  I even tried them without a top coat, and they stayed for 2 days.

title: Beautiful color, long lasting wear
text:
I LOVE Kiss nails!! I get so many complements, and people always ask me where I got my nails done and they can't believe they're press ons. The key is to lightly file the top of the nail so the nail glue adheres better and longer and add drops to both your natural nail and a drop inside the fake nail. Press for 10-15 seconds and they will stay in place for days. I keep the spare nails in a ziploc baggie with the nail file and glue in my purse in case I need to make a quick repair on the go.

FYI the pink nail glue that comes with the nails is OK, it adheres for about 3-4 days without lifting but the Amazon IBC brush on nail glue is AWESOME! Once applied, I can easily go 7-10 days without a lift and no nail fungus! (the photo is of the Kiss Jelly Fantasy nails KGFJ01)

title: Wow!
text:
My sister just got one of these Emjoi Micro-Pedis from Amazon, and told me about it. Love it!

I have included a photo of my actual feet's results. Note that my "before" is NOT me neglecting my feet. On the contrary, it was taken just days after I spent half an hour on my tiring old razor, Ped-Egg, rasp, pumice stone routine. (And sometimes I would rasp off too much, then it would hurt to walk a few days. Ouch!)

This product seems designed to prevent removing too much skin. If you push too hard the machine will basically stop. So, I find it best to let the machine do the work for me, just let it spin and spin, and I only apply gentle pressure…just enough pressure that the spinning slows slightly. It's so easy to use that I can do it almost without looking while watching TV.

I like the extension handle, particularly because it catches the powdered skin that comes out the holes on the device's underside. I just empty it into a small garbage can periodically as I go. The handle also makes it nice to reach around the far side of my foot since I am definitely not a contortionist. Make sure you firmly snap the device under the ridge that holds it into the extension handle: then it holds it nice and snug.

Overall, a nice little device. Reasonable price, too.

title: Best fake nails, outside actual acrylic powder.
text:
I love that impress has an OPI partnership, because thier colors are my fav. While i bought some before, ive used these almost exclusively for the last 2.5 years since they partnered.

PROS: These stick ons are super durable. The flex with your nail instead of breaking when you hit something hard. (Which is a big plus for me since my acrylics always break from use and bend my natural nail backwards in the process.) These wont damage your nails if removed properly. Mine usually stay on between 10-15 days. I dont file the top to rough them up anymore, but they lasted 2+ weeks back when i did do that step. Ive used them for years and only ever had an issue with them not lasting when i forgot the alcohol step - which is an absolute must and non negotiable for a good result.

CON: The other impress nails (longer ones and coffin shapes) look pretty but dont seem to last more than 5-7 days.

If you ever have an issue, email impress directly and they will send you a new pack. Their customer service is fantastic.

PICTURES: these are from the last couples years. All are Kiss ImPress Press On Manicure nails, and all but the coffin ones are OPI partnership.

title: ''from a beginners point of view'' I would definitely recommend if you are looking for some solid trimmers at ...
text: My oldest brother taught me a few things about cutting hair when I was younger, however, as a disclaimer, I am in no means, shape, or form a professional barber so no disrespect to the trade or anyone that does it for a living....mad props!  I am a review junkie but I also know that each person is different and expecting different results when they purchase a product based on what THEY are looking for.  I am a black male with a lengthy sized beard and dreadlocks and my miniature Wahl  trimmers gave way on me after a few years......they were inexpensive and did the trick so I did get my money back ten times off of them but was in the market for a replacement.  From a ''beginners'' point of view, these trimmers are solid.  I reviewed everything here on Amazon and even looked at vids on Youtube and decided to go with these trimmers as an inexpensive option.  As I said before, ''from a beginners point of view'' I would definitely recommend if you are looking for some solid trimmers at home (even though I seen countless vids of professional barbers utilizing) to give you a crisp line on your hair and beard.  Lightweight, compact, and cuts like a champ....packs power in such a small trimmer....(small to me because I do have bear paw hands)!  I did give it a 4-star rating because mine did come packaged with a Panasonic battery and I am sure that there would be a difference in the trimmers abilities if I went with a more powerful top of the line battery.  All in all, great trimmer, and Wahl has done it again...for me anyway!

text: I ordered a #1/2 (1.5mm) clip for my Wahl clippers.  Unfortunately, the tines broke the first time the clip was used. My older clips are much sturdier and have withstood hundreds of cuttings.  The photos taken show the older clip (solid black) and the newer clip (metal plate).  I did expect the #1/2 (1.5mm) smaller clip to have thinner tines (given its purpose to cut closer to the scalp), but I did not expect the tines to break off on the first use.

text:

Even going over it dozens of time, it still feels uneven. I wear the one-length-all-over-including-beard hairstyle you might associate with Jason Statham. title: Lovely product, cheap shipping
text:
I am just beginning to shave with a straight razor and this is the first strop i've decided to buy. I bought it because of the high reviews and it seemed like a quality purchase, something that would last me a while.

I received this strop in a small box. It came rolled up, which was a red flag, but I was excited to check it out and it looked like a beautiful piece of leather. However, upon further investigation i noticed a couple stretches, one near the base by 'made in usa' and the other right in the center :(. Almost looking dried and cracked. Now, by no means am i an expert on strops but I can't imagine these ripples would be good for the edge of the razor. This is probably from being rolled up in packaging, and I wouldn't blame the company for this but come on there has to be some kind of quality control in shipping. I paid good money and wouldn't mind paying an extra couple of bucks to actually receive the product as it's sold.

If you ask me this should be shipped flat in a long narrow box rather than rolled up in a cube box.

Once again, I'm just beginning with straight razors and have no other strops to compare so if these wrinkles are alright then I'll gladly change my review to five stars.

title: The Pinnacle of Fine Leather Craftsmanship
text:
This strop will outlive you or me. Heck, this will survive nuclear war. The quality of the leather on this thing is something you have to smell, feel, and see to truly believe. Aside from very high end handmade cowboy boots and Italian loafers you'd be hard pressed to find this level of leather craftsmanship anywhere else. Simply put, the strop is beautiful. The handles are incredibly thick hardened leather riveted with ornate stainless steel rivets. The rings are clearly hefty and are made to last generations. The canvas half is actually ballistic-weave nylon which is very thick and has been finished to be completely smooth: no hanging threads. The leather band of the strop itself is super thick but with the perfect amount of draw and flex.

Even the design is brilliant: the leather and the "canvas" are separate with separate handles, but they're riveted together at the top. You can start out on the canvas side and easily flip the strop over since the ring rotates on an articulated clip.

Amish quality really is the gold standard... I am lost for words. And remember, this is a strop I'm talking about.

title: Quality control anyone?
text:
**UPDATE**
Mike at Royal Shave quickly responded to my complaint and shipped me a replacement strop! The new one is an amazing product, I can't stress that enough. I couldn't imagine finding one with better quality or workmanship and should last many years with proper care.

This still doesn't explain how the first one slipped through the cracks, but the customer service provided was commendable in rectifying the problem.

I just unboxed the strop and there is a thumb sized gouge taken out of the rough side of the leather, the leather remaining feels paper thin and has caused a dull spot on the stropping side. This is an unused strop and is unsatisfactory for for the price paid. Not sure if it will effect the ability to hone my razor, but will undoubtedly reduce the longevity of the product.

Before I used the fashionable French stuff in tubes, also another high priced water based wax, but this stuff works far better!

title: keeps the crew cut looking like it should
text: keeps the crew cut looking like it should.  About as close to butch wax from the 60's as you will find.  Smell isn't the same but consistency is.

title: Old school pomade
text: I use this wax before I put my water based pomade.  It adds more control and holds my hair in place.  I use Groom and Clean and a fine toothed comb to get the wax out. This is a typical old fashioned oil based pomade.

title: Hold well but very sticky during application
text: My barber introduced me to this product. It definitely has great control. The only thing is that it is very sticky so it pulls at your hair as you're applying it. Would be nice if it was able to glide through your hair better during initial application.

title: I really love Lucky Tiger Cru Butch Wax
text:
I really love Lucky Tiger Cru Butch Wax. It makes my hair look better than any other pomade I;ve ever used before. Believe me, I've used a massive amount of pomades in the best, The only drawback of the Butch Wax is how hard it is to wash out, I shampooed my hair three times and used Suave Groom and Clean, and I still have a fair amount of Butch Wax in my hair after all that. It's way, way more difficult to wash out than Murray's Superior. I haven't tried olive oil or mineral oil to try and loosen it up, I might have to because I don't want to have to spend three to four days decreasing. The way I see it, using Butch Wax is like a two week per month job. I spend a week with it in my hair and then next entire week trying to get it out of my hair. I would look good for two weeks per month,

Initially, the Butch Wax went in like a light medium. It's real creamy. However, with the way that it stays in your hair, it eventually firms it up due to the wax over time. I guess that's why it's so perfect for crew cuts and flat tops. The stuff stays in your hair no matter what and makes it firm.

title: Four Stars
text: Good Stuff! Recommend for short hair. USMC

title: Same stuff.
text: Great!  You can't beat it for standing up flattops.  Better than KrewComb.

title: Same Great Cru-Butch Wax Of The 1950’s-60’s!
text:
At 65 and balding I joined my fellow old guys and buzzed my head to a crew cut and to keep it neat and standing up I bought a jar of the same stuff my dad bought me for the crew cut I wore until I was 13, and again while I was in the Army: Lucky Tiger!
This is the exact same butch wax it was in the 1960’s. So nice to know there’s one or two things still around from our youth that gives quality at a good price!
Keeps my crew standing up without being too greasy, and lasts all day once your hair is trained. There was another similar product back then called LB butch wax, now long gone, but it was the exact same thing as Lucky Tiger Cru-Butch wax and smells better! Rub some between your fingers to smooth it out then just smooth it over your hair/entire head and then get your Mens butch brush (military hair brush) out and brush it back! Keeps your crew cut standing up and neat all day!
You can’t go wrong with Lucky Tiger!

title: Great  stuff to keep hair in place on windy days.
text: Used up my jar of butch was long ago and very excited to see them carried by Amazon.  Ordered jar immeditally and it is just like the one purchased years ago.  Keep my hair in place in the wind and easly washes out.

title: Good, close shave
text:
After five years, it was time to ditch my old norelco... it pulled when I went too long without shaving, took about 10 passes to cut everything, and didn't hold much charge as a cordless...
Tried to buy a more expensive razor, it was out of stock, so I got this one. I was really surprised at first how little irritation there was. My old Norelco was giving a bit of irriatation in places, but no problems with this one, even though it was a new razor. First time I used it was on 6-days growth, and there was none of the painful pulling I was used to. To top it off, the shave was so much closer. I really have no complaints about this razor... I'm very impressed with the improvements made, and don't really see a reason to get the $100+ shavers...
With the Norelco guarentee on top of the performance, I'll be sticking with their products for another 5 years...

title: Great value
text:
I've used this shaver for a year and am buying another (not because it is broke). Norelco suggests that you replace the blades once a year. Replacement blades cost about 2/3 the cost of the whole shaver. Therefore better idea to just buy another shaver once a year or so and rotate the old one to the travel bag, the office, the car, etc. That way when one dies there is always another nearby. The shave is decent. I've owned better Norelcos with higher RPMs, however.

Sure this one doesn't have a charge indicator and uses the old type Ni-Cad batteries. But just plug it in overnight once a week and you're set. I love gadgets and electronics, but do I really need charge indicators on a shaver? Simplify and spend your $ on more fun things at Amazon :-)

title: I've had better
text: This is a very basic shaver.  A downside is that the shaver does not work with the cord in when the charge runs out.  A good thing is that the charge lasts over a week.  A downside is that the closeness is not adjustable.  It gets a close shave but not great.  The flexible heads are good.  I wish I would have spent a few more bucks and got a better shaver.

title: Hit a home run with this shaver
text: I never owned an electric shaver before, but I hit a homer with this one. Used it 20 times so far and haven't had to recharge it. Easy to clean, and does a nice job. Completely satisfied with my purchase.

title: Too much stubble
text: You know, I'm surprised this shaver was not better by the reviews.  I used to use my Dad's very old Norelco shaver and I thought it cut great.  Then my gf bought me a Remington shaver 5 years ago that I've been using since that cut cleaner, but wasn't as soft as my Norelco shaver.  So I decided to finally upgrade and I bought this shaver thinking it would be good.  Well it leaves too much stubble and the sideburn trimmer doesn't cut that well.  Better than nothing, but not better than much.

title: A great cordless razor
text:
My old Norelco cordless had finally reached the point where the charge was only good for about 3 shaves and then it would pull the hair more than cut it. This was after about 5 years of use though. I decided to stay with Norelco and try this razor.

First off this razor is much quieter than my old one. Secondly, the shave is very close and comfortable. No pulling or nicking at all. I am very happy with it so far.

title: Great deal!
text: This is a great shaver and a great deal bought through Amazon.com, We had been looking for a good Men's Electric Razor, and when we happened across this deal, it was just too good to pass up! My husband loves the way it glides over his sensitive skin--he was very tired of having to use the old shaving cream and disposable razors every morning--very boring! This way he can even sit outside and watch the squirrels play and the birds visiting the bird house while shaving! Thank You!

title: Gets the job done.
text: With a remarkably low noise level, and what are apparently slower turning blades than on my previous (6 year old) Norelco, this rather low priced model does a creditable job, although as has been my experience in the past, nothing shaves a close as a blade.  But then again, nothing removes the top layer of skin like a blade.  Easy to clean, and I although I shave 6 days per week, I have only been charging it up every other week.  In short, if it holds up for a year, for slightly more than the price of a replacement head, I have a new shaver.

title: Fantastic Value - Great Razor
text: When my last Norelco electric razor finally wore out after almost 18 years of service, I purchased the "top-of-the-line" Remington rotary electric razor. What a mistake. After using it for just under a year, I trashed it and decided to purchase the Norelco 6613X Reflex Plus Electric Razor. It proved to be a wise decision. It is compact in size and easy to hold. It provides a shave that's as close to a blade shaver as you could possibly get plus the Amazon.com purchase price was $[...] less than the regular, suggested retail price.

title: Finally a good electric shaver.
text:
This is the fourth electric razor I have purchased in the past 2-3 years. It works. It doesn't iritate my face and I don't have to use a safety razor once a week to clean up the hairs it misses.

Sure, it is not as close as a safety razor, and the battery last only 2-3 shaves instead of the week of shaves I was expecting. But, overall I am very happy and would buy another.

The price was less than half the retail list and much lower than I could get locally. Worth going on-line for.

title: The Base Enhances Results, Extends Time Between Next Dye
text: I think many guys are just buying the dye because it works well enough on its own.  But after a couple applications of the brown dye alone, I decided to buy the Organic Base just to see if it makes a difference...and it does.  When I just use the dye for 30 minutes and then wash it out, my beard/skin has that ever so slight green tint for the first 24 hrs, then a natural brown color with blondish highlights (where gray used to be) settles in nicely and lasts for about 4 days before the dye's color starts to fade away.  When I use the base first for 20 minutes, wash it out, then apply the brown dye for 20 minutes and wash it out, I don't notice any green tint at all, and the dye's color lasts about 7 days before needing another application.  So for me I'm going to continue to use the base first so I only have to dye my beard once a week to keep it looking good.  Very happy with Grizzly Mountain products.

title: Went from 50% Gray Coverage to about 90%!
text: I've used Grizzly Mountain Beard Dye for nearly a year now.  It's awesome, looks natural, and doesn't burn my face off like the over-the-counter brands do (I'm HIGHLY allergic).  I recently went back to a stubble beard.  I noticed the dye didn't stick to my short gray beard hairs like it did when they were longer.  I decided to give this a whirl.  All I can say is...IT WORKS!  I still have a few grays here and there (natural) but this stuff REALLY helped the regular dye stick to my short gray hairs (I use the dark brown color).  It takes twice as long for me to do the dye job now (and more often - with stubble it's about every 2-3 days) but the result is totally worth it.  I feel too young to look that old and this product helps me achieve perfect results without looking "fake."  I'm writing this after just one application.  I am anticipating the next round will be even better.

title: Works as advertised
text: This really made a difference in coloring my beard. I have stubborn gray, this product when used right before I apply the beard dye, really softens the follicles and allows the beard dye to cover my gray better

title: Works well if you like green and magenta
text:
We found this product to be a great alternative to just for men. It did not blister my husband’s face and provided a good color and made is beard soft

It does come with some cons though. My husband had to color his beard every 4 days, it completely lost its luster and the beard oils seemed to rid his beard of color. If he did not color as often the dark part of his beard turned magenta and gray had hints of green so it was kinda looking a little like Christmas.

Unfortunately he had to stop using it. We did find that Just For Men creates a beard shampoo that does a great job (for now) coupled with using Clairol natural with no ammonia once a month does the trick.

title: It's all natural and organic!! Looks natural too!!
text:
Best organic dye ever! Glad I found this product getting ready to order more and thought I'd let you know how great this dye is.

I used it for my hair and beard and body hair too!

I apply the organic base for the full time of 30min then rinse and dry then apply the dye for 30min! Worked great! My beard took 2 rounds ofbthe above process to completely get my white chin hair brown again and I love it! I reapply once every 2 weeks or so or when I trim up!

You can't go wrong with the grizz!!

title: Disappointed
text: Not worth it. Maybe it's because I have naturally thicker hair. I tried using this on my goatee for weeks. I used the beard base with the dye daily for about a week to try and "tame" my beard before using just the dye. I usually applied it and slept in it overnight to try and give the color enough time to really oxidize. What I would get once I washed it all off was just a goatee that looked like salt with just a pinch more pepper than it had in it before going through that ordeal. I used this daily for about a month to give it some time to fully run through my beard, but still got the same results, so I stopped using it. I could find better things to do with hours of my time.

title: Adds natural color with no allergic response
text:
The organic base is part of a kit sold by the manufacturer. A while back I was a user of a standard beard dye on the market, you know, exclusively for males. After using the commercial product for years, I began to develop horrible allergic reactions ( weeping sores) and had to discontinue.
Enter Grizzly, I have been a happy user for two years now and very satisfied. Initially, I had to "break-in" my beard to the product using the organic base- although each person is different-not everyone needs it ( The manufacturer instructions ask to try without it and use if you need assistance for "breaking in" your tough beard). The organic base helps provide a specific tone range and probably helps the absorbency of the beard and a small amount is given with the standard kit. Recently I found myself using the organic base consistently so I ordered a package of it separately. Give these folks a try. Your beard will look natural and you won't get "burned" by harsh chemicals. Comes in powdered form appears to be all natural vegetable and mineral pigment dyes. Instructions are clear and you can contact them for additional support ( I don't usually - still its nice to know the option is there)

title: I'm glad I gave this product a shot!
text: After reading the reviews, I was a little nervous about trying this and dying my beard green, but I'm glad I gave this a shot. Unlike some of the folks that used this product, I followed the instructions to the letter and also made sure to use the base first. I applied the base and let it sit the full 30 min. The gray hairs in my beard DID have a slight hint of green.  I then generously applied the beard dye and let that sit also for the full 30 min. The outcome looked extremely natural, not fake like Just for Men. It didn't eliminate all of my gray, but it did eliminate a large amount of it. I'm going to try it again in a few days and I have a feeling it will look even better after another application. I highly recommend this product to anyone looking for a natural product and a natural look.

title: I am not paid for reviews nor do I receive discounts for them
text:
But I have to write a review of this!!!
I have like the most pin-straight hair ever... ive tried curling irons, crimpers, scrunching, braids and even pin-curls (yes, what they did in the 1950's!!)
My hair does NOT keep a curl. I've used 400 degree irons resulting in barely a wave... ive even had my hair professionally curled. And the curls lasted for about 2 hours before I was a frizzy disaster. For the last few years I had all but given up on my dream of a head of locks. Until now that is!
I saw this bed head rock n roller for just 30 bucks on prime.. I figured I'd most likely return it but wanted to try because of the reviews. And I am sooo glad I did! IT WORKS!!! HALLELUJAH! IT ACTUALLY WORKS!
My hair curled with EASE! Like so easily! I am seriously shocked... and so happy with this purchase. 2 of my good friends have already purchased this since they saw me with curls! They know how my hair is impossible to curl, but they saw it themselves!
Ok about the actual product... it has heat setting from low to high and anywhere in between, you can make big or small curls with the bumps (either spiraling over the bumps for bigger curls, or in between bumps for tighter curls.....or a fun messy mix of both), it has a nice long cord for easy movement and it heats up in literally 90 seconds.... no more waiting 10 minutes for a potential fire to start. I tried using the glove but it just got in my way of seperating hair.. you dont need it though anyway. Best part about it... it actually curls hair! (Imagine my surprise lol)
I played with it as soon as it arrived.. I put some curls in my hair and my 5 yr old daughters hair too... we were in for the night and after I easily gave us 2 happy heads of locks we went to sleep. THE NEXT MORNING I woke up with damn near perfect curls still in tact! The both of us did! I didn't even use hairspray! And I am like the energizer bunny in my sleep and my 5 yr old is...well, 5. We all know how they move in their sleep! So I was totally shocked that they stayed in all night! Im putting up a pic from the morning after we curled..still in pjs lol... i didnt take one that night, bc i was planning on doing it better before posting a pic lol but i have to share the morning after pic bc it was such a wonderful moment in my life lol; to realize I could now curl my hair after 29 years of life!
So overall, yes! Buy this product! Do it!! You wont regret it! And, if you are like me and have trouble curling your hair, well THIS will do the trick! I definitely recommend it!!

title: A Bit Difficult to Use but Produces Very Pretty Curls!
text:
For many years I've always straightened my hair because I cannot seem to get the hang of using curling irons to make pretty spiral curls. Wearing the same hairstyle all the time with long hair can get a bit boring so I decided to search on Amazon for styling tools that are easy to use. I initially ordered the [[ASIN:B003FBI9LS Bed Head Deep Waver]] and really loved the results so much that I also purchased this Rock 'n' Roller styling iron, which I affectionately call my "bubble curler."

The Bed Head Rock 'n' Roller Ceramic Styling Iron comes with the iron itself along with a black protective glove to protect your hand from the heat of this iron since there is no clamp. The iron measures almost 15 inches in length, with the heating barrel measuring about 5 3/4 inches. The balls measure about one inch in diameter. The cord measures almost six feet so there is plenty of length to move around with it. The iron has a black ball at the top so you can hold it while using it, a safety stand that works well, an on/off switch, a temperature dial that allows you to choose among the low, medium, and high settings as well as the temperatures in between all of them, and a swivel cord so you can easily move the iron around as you use it. I found that it heats up quickly and cools off rapidly as well in case you need to pack it up in your suitcase soon after using it. The glove fits well but I didn't end up using it since it feels a bit awkward to use while trying to grip strands of hair so I took a chance and kept my hand bare, with no problems as long as I styled my hair in front of a mirror so I could watch closely what I was doing.

I found this styling iron a bit difficult to use at first but it gets easier with practice. I just winged it and have included some pictures of my end result. There is a chart in the instructions as to what heat setting is most likely appropriate for your hair type but they recommend you start with the lowest setting and increase the heat as needed. I have wavy to medium hair so I started off using the low setting but ended up using the medium setting. I have long hair and it was fairly simple to wrap my hair around the barrel. When I got toward the end of the strands of hair, I carefully wrap them around the barrel, holding my fingers as close as I can to the styling iron without actually touching it. Then I roll the styling iron towards my head as close as I can so my hair gets curled as much as possible. I hold my hair in that position for about 40 seconds and then release it and curl my whole head. It probably took about a half hour to style all of my hair and then I finished by spraying it with hairspray. I didn't add any product to my hair before I started although you probably could if your hair works better that way.

Overall, I am happy with this styling iron and really like the end result. Hopefully it will get easier to use with time. I found it a bit difficult to use because, without having a clamp on the iron, I had to hold both arms up in the air and my muscles got tired pretty quickly. I'm in fairly good shape but perhaps this will get easier with time. I actually prefer the [[ASIN:B003FBI9LS Bed Head Deep Waver]] because I feel it's easier to use and I love the beach waves I get from it so I will most likely use that one more but this one is still good to have. If you want spiral curls, I'd purchase the Rock 'n' Roller Styling Iron but if you prefer beach waves, I'd purchase the Deep Waver. The price is just what I wanted to spend and I like the fact that I can have more hairstyles than just straightened hair! I recommend purchasing this styling iron if you want to add some variety to your hairstyle and aren't comfortable using a regular curling iron to get spiral curls.

The wand used in these videos was a part of a set that was over $100.  I didn't want to pay that price for the set, so I searched the internet for a more affordable bubble wand.  I found this one at a very affordable price and although I was skeptical that it'd be able to give me the same results as the expensive one I had seen in the tutorial videos, I figured I'd give it a try since I could return it for free if not satisfied.  Well let me tell you, I'm highly satisfied!!  The wand gives me amazing curls that literally last for 3-4 days....which is really impressive.  Normally my curls using a 1" wand only last about 1-2 days and day 2 they don't have a lot of life left in them.  My curls using the bubble wand had tons of life in them on day 4 and I got compliments every day on how great my curls looked.  This bubble wand offers amazing results at a very affordable price…it’s a most buy!  I normally don’t right reviews, but this bubble wand definitely deserves a great review.

title: Love this wand!
text: I'm not going to lie and say using this particular wand was not time consuming...it definitely was, but the results are worth it.  I have very long hair, so wrapping was a bit of a struggle because the wand is only so long.  I was able to wrap around both the balls and the indents, giving a unique curl effect.  Works best to physically unwrap the strand of hair you're curling rather than pulling downward as with a traditional clipless wand.  Any reviews stating this wand does not give curl either has too short of hair, isn't using a high enough heat setting, or is completely doing it wrong.  You really need to use your right hand over your head to curl the left and vice versa for the right.  The black cool tip should be pointing downward as you curl.  There are some informative videos on YouTube for how to curl with this wand.  Anyhow, I'm pleased with this wand and look forward to many great looks from it.

I've been resting my flat iron on random surfaces every morning and slowly melting them, so I finally decided to be responsible and get a mat. I wanted something simple, and this one could also be rolled up around a heat tool to stuff in a suitcase, so I chose this one.

I've put this on the corner of my vanity, and it works great. I can put a flat iron and a clampless curling wand on top, and nothing burns and nothing smells. I also sometimes put hot pots on top and use it as a pot holder. It's a perfect small, compact size.

I think the only possible con is that since it's a black rubbery surface, it picks up lots of dust and dirt. text:

Her flat iron is a Paul Mitchell something or other (about 1.25") and fits perfectly. The opening appears that it would hold up to a 1.5" flat iron depending on the exact dimensions. The plastic gets hot while her iron is in it, but I see no reason why it would melt or catch fire. I purposely tested it with her flat iron just sitting in the holder for 30 minutes, and while the plastic was hot to the touch (go figure her flat iron is set at 410 degrees ), it does not appear to be a safety or fire hazard.

My only complaint is that I cannot get the suction cups to stick to any smooth surface for more than 24 hours. I've tried smooth tile, the smooth granite counter, and the glass mirror for mounting surfaces. title: Mixed feelings!!
text:
UPDATED REVIEW: changed from 4 stars to 1 star due to paint chipping on clamp.

In my original review, I gave this product 4 stars due to the ease of use– it’s super convenient and rotates as it should. A huge time saver, and it’s actually fun to use! I knocked a star because my curls would always immediately fall when using this tool. My hair has always held curls very well with other hot tool products, with the exception of this rotating iron.

I’ve come back to update my review and change the rating to 1 star because I’ve used this tool less than 10 times and I noticed yesterday that the clamp has started chipping paint really bad (see pics attached). The quality isn’t the best, and for what I paid, I don’t feel like this product is worth it. Thankfully, I’m still within the return window so I’m returning for a refund. I’ll be using the money I get back to purchase the name brand version of this item. Hopefully the extra money it costs will be worth a better curl and a higher quality product.

title: READ ME!! Great for Using the Tension Blow Dry Method on 4C Low Porosity Hair!
text:
Not sure why, but one day after one of my comb attachments broke on the Gold N Hot Styler (for like the 4th time), I decided to see what the brush attachment could do. Wow, Wow, Wow. I was pleasantly surprised. If your hair is coarse and thick, do not expect this to grip your hair very firmly and pull through like a comb. Instead, detangle your hair first then use this as a stretching tool. I used the creme of nature blow dry creme and I hold my hair in my palm on one side and the blow dryer with the brush attachment in the other and pull gently in a downwards motion (see the tension method on youtube). My hair was blown out with all the moisture from my leave ins .. in no time flat. I only use the medium setting. My hair does not suffer from heat damage at all as I properly moisturize and use leave in conditioner and oils before I use the tool.

Minus one star because the first time I used it the bristles on the edges began to curve outwards. I suspect that was due to me holding the hair to firmly against the brush. We'll see how long it lasts before the bristles make this unusable. Will try to be light handed.

title: This is THE molecule for you!
text: I bought Molecule 2 first, after watching a YouTube video about boosting fragrances that don't project well.  That one, to me, smelled like cotton candy.  Since these won't break the bank I decided to order Molecule 1 and Holy Moly!  I love that it is a pure molecule - you know how fragrances these days smell very complex?  Well, this is a simple, basic note that to me smells metallic and musky, in a VERY good way!  My nose picks it up very well and it is gorgeous - I will layer my weaker YSL fragrances with it but I will also wear it alone because I like it that much!  To me it is definitely a masculine scent, and I agree w/ others - it probably depends on your skin chemistry with this, which to me is a unique bonus - because that makes it a different scent on every person.  Since this takes 3 weeks to arrive and the bottle is not that big, I will be buying another very soon!  Highly recommend :)

title: Strange product
text:
I may have gotten this because of the hype in the description. I mean, "SPICE UP ANY ROOM WITH A SIGNATURE FRAGRANCE THAT WILL NEVER GO AWAY," is an awesome tagline, if not a little chilling. I mean, never?!? It also makes your stinky clothes fresh and can take away dandruff and clean your hair. Yes, it's a little unbelievable, but if even half that is true...

So I got this small bottle to try. It smells like baby powder. Very strong, concentrated baby powder. It may indeed "never go away." But some people really like the smell of baby powder, and, even though I never used baby powder on my babies, it still brings back a nostalgia. It's pleasant. I do not know if baby powder will "spice" up a room, but it might be more pleasant that what is stinking up the place, and this will supersede many odors. I'm skeptical of the other claims as well. But, if you're looking for a sort of sketchy vial (it has a picture of a baby and a giant pile or white powder and the words "Powder Supreme") that smells strongly of baby powder, then this is definitely the one and only one you want.

title: Strong oil, smells as described.
text:
This is exactly what it claims to be; a perfume oil that smells like baby powder. It is pretty strong, so a little amount gives out a lot of baby smell. I couldn’t quite figure out where to use this product. From the little roll-on bottle, it looks like it is best used by applying on skin as a fragrance, but I suppose carrying baby smell as a fragrance is a matter taste. I don’t feel comfortable with applying an oil to my clothes to “take [them] from stinking to smelling great.” The other suggested uses (e.g., eliminating dandruff or relieving sore muscles) with such small amount sound like a bit of a stretch. Maybe putting on cotton and using as air-freshener would be a good use, but it is hard to do with the roll-on. If I have to remove the roller to apply on a cotton ball, I would be nervous about spilling the oil.

All in all, a good oil with strong baby smell in an easy to use roll-on bottle.
